text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, such incredible intensity...!
I feel like I'm about to be overwhelmed... But—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Family
text_block_list.text:
Verxina~~~~!!
Verxina-chaaaan!!
Big sis!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, I'm...
the number one!! Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Haa...!
Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall remember this.
...Together with the blue flames.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Alright!!
Alright...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fist pump driven purely by emotion,
so unlike her usual self.
However, that was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Proof that Verxina felt she had made a breakthrough.
Brimming with confidence—she had returned.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis...
I'm so glad♡

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
That was amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Thank you so very much
for inviting me!
choice_data_list: No, thank YOU for all your help!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"No, no!
We're the ones who should be thanking you!"
choice_data_list: No, no, I should be the one—

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
All of us together were able to support Verxina-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
That girl
can definitely become even stronger, don't you think? ♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah! Cheva-chi~?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
To go up against the likes of Orfe-san...
and pull off a race like that.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...She'd never been that down before.
She really is strong... my sister.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...You really are...
different from me after all—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I have returned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that Verxina's mind is made up,
what we must decide next...
is the path she will take moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Back at the Shuka Sho, we talked about
challenging the Senior Tiara route races
after the Osaka Hai, but..."
choice_data_list: As you are now, you could keep going down this path just as you are.
As you are now, you can keep going down this path.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: When you say "just like this"...
choice_data_list: It's the path to chasing after Gentildonna

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without confining myself to a single route, competing against Umamusume
from the Classic Triple Crown path...
Walking the path of the strongest... I proved that strength today.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: For now, I won't chase after them.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"If we aim for the top...
we're bound to clash again."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Just as I decided from the very beginning,
I will... strive to become the queen I envision.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Displaying a splendid, supple strength...
I will guide my younger sisters toward a better path.
And stand tall as a proud figure—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I will dethrone that person—
who vanished from the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
First is the race that crowns the Mile Queen...
The Victoria Mile!
choice_data_list: Ah, let's go down your own path!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, together with a Verxina who has
reclaimed her noble pride...
we set our sights on the Victoria Mile!
choice_data_list: Once you're ready, go home with your family.
Once you're ready, head home with your family, okay?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, where is Trainer?
choice_data_list: ...You know, with the paperwork and all that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To tell the truth, I had no particular business with you... but since your family had gathered, I thought you should spend private time together with them.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I will gladly take you up on your offer, then.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
――Big Sis, are you really heading back to the dorms already?
Come home with us~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it still in time to submit an overnight stay form?
Let's have a post-race celebration party, pretty please??

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't worry.
I have a meeting first thing in the morning anyway.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I'll wait for Trainer here.
...See you tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh,
Shion-san?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Good work today!
...You were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You watched
today's race, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Since I made such bold declarations to you,
I'm relieved it didn't end in an embarrassing defeat."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
How was that?
...Was I able to be of some help to you?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I don't really get it.
But...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
When I saw the two of them lined up together...
man, it really fired me up!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The one who should be there... standing side-by-side...
—is "me."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let her beat me...!
...My fire's lit now."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
In the end,
I'm just me through and through, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The only way to clear this haze...
is to defeat them myself.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"That resolved my determination.
In that sense, you really gave me strength.
Thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I will be cheering on your rehab.
Well then, good night.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Miss Shion?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...'Cause that's not it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm...
not a little sister.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I will definitely
make a comeback.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"And then... I'll put on a performance
that totally blows Orfe out of the water—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get strong enough
that you can lean on me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway, that's how it is.
So please, don't burden yourself
with my problems anymore."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm NOT your little sister!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Sound good?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Please get some good rest.
Thank you for your hard work today.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After wandering around town without much aim, it had gotten quite late.
Hurrying back to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: N-No, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Let's head back.
I look forward to working with you again starting tomorrow.
